club.historyText1: Founded in 1978, the Planeurs d'Ille-et-Vilaine (PIV) association is a passionate soaring club based at Saint-Sulpice-des-Landes aerodrome, in the heart of Brittany. For over 45 years, we have been sharing our passion for silent flight with pilots of all levels.
club.historyText2: Today, our club has around fifty active members and a varied fleet of gliders, suited to both training and performance flying. Each year we welcome many trainees and offer discovery flights to introduce soaring to the wider public.
club.passionText: Soaring is more than a sport — it is a passion. We share the wonder of flying in silence, carried by air currents, with total respect for the environment.
club.safetyText: Safety is at the heart of everything we do. Rigorous training, exemplary maintenance, systematic briefings — we make no compromises when it comes to flight safety.
club.communityText: PIV is above all a community of enthusiasts. Mutual support, friendliness and sharing are the pillars of our club life, whether on the airfield or over a drink at the clubhouse.
club.ctaText: Whether you are a curious beginner or an experienced pilot, there is a place for you at PIV.

fleet.heroSubtitle: Discover the gliders of our club

aerodrome.descriptionText1: Saint-Sulpice-des-Landes aerodrome (ICAO code: LFES) is located in Ille-et-Vilaine, about 40 km south of Rennes. This grass strip, ideally located in the heart of the Breton countryside, offers remarkable flying conditions for soaring.
aerodrome.descriptionText2: The main east-west runway (09/27) is 800 metres long and allows for both winch and aerotow launches. The site benefits from a favourable aerological environment, with good thermal conditions in season.
aerodrome.hangarText: A large hangar houses our entire fleet of gliders as well as the tow plane. The gliders are prepared and taken out each flying day.
aerodrome.briefingText: A well-equipped room for weather briefings, theoretical courses and post-flight debriefings. An essential tool for pilot training.
aerodrome.clubhouseText: A friendly space to meet fellow pilots, share a meal or simply enjoy the view of the airfield. The heart of club life.
aerodrome.accessText: The aerodrome is located at Saint-Sulpice-des-Landes (35390). From Rennes, take the RN 137 towards Bain-de-Bretagne, then follow signs to Saint-Sulpice-des-Landes. The aerodrome is signposted at the entrance to the village.
